$comment-mergeQueue-numberCardsBeforeEnq: Hash cards are numbered in batches on main after landing; PR heads remain unchanged. WE_MQ_NUMBER_CARDS_BEFORE_ENQUEUE can restore branch numbering.
$comment-postMergeNumbering: Number at queue idle, at maxPending, or after maxAgeMinutes (10, below the 30-minute standards grace). Overrides: WE_MQ_POST_MERGE_MAX_PENDING, WE_MQ_POST_MERGE_MAX_AGE_MINUTES, WE_MQ_POST_MERGE_WHEN_QUEUE_IDLE.
